BuildDimensions.description: Building size in whole nodes chosen by the player. Not a player or avatar size.

Catalogue.x-meaning: The world source's own material vocabulary. emptyMaterialRef names the material that means an empty cell; it must be a key of materials.

ClearanceCells.description: Building design clearance proposed by the skill and confirmed by the player. Not a measured, templated or derived player size; it does not prove that a real player fits.

EngineRevisions.x-meaning: Opaque revisions the world source reports for what defines its materials. Compared for equality only.

GeometryProfile.x-meaning: Geometry profile of a payload. This major defines only voxel-grid/v1: integer grid positions, closed integer boxes, one material per cell. Another profile is a new variant added beside it, never a change of this one. A payload whose profile the world source does not declare is refused with CAPABILITY_GAP, never guessed.

LightRule.x-meaning: minimumLight is normalised: 0 is the darkest and 1 the brightest light level the world source reports. The world source maps its own light scale onto it.

MaterialTags.x-meaning: Neutral tags the world source normalises from its own material definitions. placeable is the world source's conclusion that the material can be written and restored on its declared write path with no side effect and no persistent state; null is unknown and never treated as false or true. Raw engine fields stay in extension and are never read outside the world source.

OpaqueCode.x-normalization: NONE; exact Unicode scalar sequence; never trim/lower/NFC; not a path
OpaqueCode.x-meaning: A reason code defined by the world source. Consumers show or relay it; they never branch on its value.

OpaqueValue.x-meaning: Any strict JSON value owned by the world source. Carried and digested unchanged; never interpreted outside the world source.

Orientation.x-meaning: Neutral orientation index of a material, from the set the Catalogue declares for that material. Conversion to an engine encoding happens only inside the world source.

Ref.x-normalization: NONE; exact Unicode scalar sequence; never trim/lower/NFC; not a path

RegionRuns.x-order: VoxelArea index order: x fastest, then y, then z

Revision.x-normalization: NONE; opaque equality, never numeric ordering

ValidateBuildProposalSourceError.x-authority: C-painter carried sample value closure; actual original source closure NOT supplied

ValidateRegionProposalSourceError.x-authority: C-painter carried sample value closure; actual original source closure NOT supplied

World_Ref.x-normalization: NONE; exact Unicode scalar sequence; never trim/lower/NFC; not a path

World_Revision.x-normalization: NONE; opaque equality, never numeric ordering

World_Partition.x-meaning: The world source's storage partition of a voxel-grid world: cells are grouped into boxes of edge[x,y,z] cells aligned at multiples of edge on each axis. Region payloads are cut along it. Declared by the world source; never assumed.

World_PostWriteLighting.x-meaning: REQUIRED: after a region write the world source recalculates light for the written box and reports a RegionLighting fact; a VERIFIED region commit or undo needs it COMPLETE. NONE: the world source has no separate light pass; no lighting fact exists and none is checked.

World_WorldGeometry.x-meaning: What the world source declares about its geometry. geometryProfiles is open: it may name profiles this contracts major does not define, and a payload profile absent from it is a CAPABILITY_GAP. partition is non-null exactly when voxel-grid/v1 is declared.

World_StateProfile.x-meaning: Declared by the world source for the state map of a Record. derivedFields are recomputed by the engine after a write and are never compared: the expected value is the readback value. preservedFields keep the before value when a cell is written. clearedFields are absent after a cell is written. The three sets are disjoint; a field in none of them is not expected to exist after a write.

World_ProtectionPrincipal.description: Basis of a CELL_PROTECTION check. ANONYMOUS: the engine asks the game's protection with no caller identity (for example core.is_protected(pos, '')), so every protected cell is refused for everyone, owners included; it is not acting-principal protection. ACTING_PRINCIPAL: the check runs for a trusted identity of the acting player; no such identity source exists in this major.

World_EngineGuardDeclaration.description: What the loaded engine payload actually checks, per guard and per stage. A stage not listed is not covered; nothing is implied by a name or a package version.

Canvas_Ref.x-normalization: NONE; exact Unicode scalar sequence; never trim/lower/NFC; not a path

Canvas_Revision.x-normalization: NONE; opaque equality, never numeric ordering

Canvas_GuardRefusal.description: Why an engine guard refused, carried beside the Error it explains. BODY_OCCUPIED/PROTECTED_CELL/PLAYER_ENCLOSED are violations of BODY_CLEARANCE/CELL_PROTECTION/PLAYER_ENCLOSURE; GUARD_UNAVAILABLE means the stage needed the guard and it is not covered (RESTORE_GUARD_UNAVAILABLE = BODY_CLEARANCE at RESTORE).

Canvas_Partition.x-meaning: The world source's storage partition of a voxel-grid world: cells are grouped into boxes of edge[x,y,z] cells aligned at multiples of edge on each axis. Region payloads are cut along it. Declared by the world source; never assumed.

Canvas_ChunkPosition.x-order: partition cell x,y,z = floor(position/partition.edge) per axis

Canvas_RegionLighting.x-meaning: Light recalculation fact of a world source that declares postWriteLighting REQUIRED. method is the world source's opaque name for how it recalculated.

Canvas_HistoryEntries.x-order: committed history order; not name order
